_about: Tier-2 multi-layer A* cost router (tools/route_pcb_astar.py + layout/router_astar.py). Where route_pcb_simple (Tier 1) does fast single-layer L/Z Manhattan, this tier runs a grid A* over (x,y,layer) with a real cost function so it can spend a VIA to reach a shorter/clearer route across two layers. Use it for the nets Tier 1 leaves as ratsnest. Every knob is here â€” no per-circuit logic, no magic numbers. enabled=false makes the tool a no-op.
_cost_doc: Path cost = travelled distance + bend_penalty_mm per 90-deg corner + off_axis_penalty_mm per step against a layer's preferred axis + via_penalty_mm per layer change. Raise via_penalty_mm to make the router hoard layers (fewer vias, longer detours); lower it to via freely. bend/off_axis are small nudges for cleaner, convention-following copper.
_max_net_span_note: 0 -> auto from the board diagonal (like route_pcb_simple).
_skip_note: Ground/return nets are left to the copper pour (auto_zones_pcb); pass force_route_nets to override.
